questions.question: Reconcile the beginning of his department headship: the post and university Chronicle give 1990–2016, whereas the SUNC department’s own history names Vavilov as its head when it was established in 1988. These may refer to different organizational stages; the source’s 1990–2016 remains in both versions pending approval. https://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/7064 ; https://internat.msu.ru/math/history-math/ .

questions.resolution: The SUNC MSU obituary gives the sequence: acting head from 15 April 1990, department head from July 1992, deputy director from September 2013 and professor from September 2014.
